application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of the maintenance and management of the sustainable drainage scheme including a full CCTV survey prior to above ground work (excluding demolition), details to show that the proposed development will achieve full 'Secured by Design' Accreditation, details of an updated version of the Whole Life Carbon Assessment prior to commencement of any work on site including all works of deconstruction and demolition, details of a Circular Economy Statement, details of a site investigation and remediation strategy and details of the depth and area and overall volume of the  of the new soils which you propose to use to create an adequate rooting environment for new tree planting and landscaping at ground level, including details of the drainage layer and other components, the soil specification and profile, the way that the proposed areas of soil will be connected to existing soil, and how the trees will be irrigated and maintained pursuant to condition 3(IV), 14(A), 23(A), 24(A), 26(Phase 2 and Phase 3), 37 of planning permission dated 31st July 2026 (RN:25/08914/FULL)
